item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
Version 1.1.2

  • Liquid Glass Indicator: The volume, brightness and Media Strip indicator is translucent Liquid Glass again on macOS 26, instead of a flat opaque panel. The coral icon and level bar stay on top.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Version 1.1.1

  • Indicator Setting: Choose where volume and brightness changes appear in Settings › General. TrackEdge (the new default) shows a coral indicator at the bottom of the screen; macOS uses Apple's own HUD.
  • Unified Indicator: Volume, brightness and Media Strip feedback now share one consistent indicator, so they never stack.
  • Accessibility is now only needed for media keys, or for Apple's HUD if you pick the macOS indicator.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Version 1.1.0

  • Automatic Updates: TrackEdge now checks for new versions once a day and can install them for you. Use ⋯ › Check for Updates… to check right away.
  • Media Strip Indicator: Swipes show what happened on screen. With Spotify and Apple Music you see the song that just started, and whether play/pause actually played or paused.
  • Typing Palm Rejection: Touches are ignored while you type, so a resting palm no longer changes your volume or brightness.
  • Lighter Haptics: All strengths are gentler, and precise mode (⇧⌥) uses an extra-light tick.
  • New Look: A new coral accent and app icon.
  • The sliders no longer grab keyboard focus.
  • The status dot only appears when something needs attention.
  • Tap to Play or Pause now has its own icon.
